Draft a daily standup blocker triage update for our AI search pod.
Design a dbt dimensional star schema with fact and dimension tables.

binary_cases.prompt: Generate a Daily Scrum sync brief for a 3-engineer mobile pod working on biometric authentication.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Must include active Sprint Goal reference, structured 3-part updates for team members (yesterday, today, blockers), and an actionable 16th-minute unblocking plan.
binary_cases.pass_fixture:
## Active Sprint Goal
Deliver 1-tap FaceID biometric login with $<200\text{ms}$ authentication latency.

## Daily Synchronization Matrix
- **Engineer A (iOS Core)**:
  - *Yesterday*: Completed LocalAuthentication framework integration and Keychain token storage.
  - *Today*: Implement fallback PIN code challenge modal.
  - *Blockers*: None.
- **Engineer B (Backend Auth API)**:
  - *Yesterday*: Deployed JWT session refresh endpoint with rate limiting.
  - *Today*: Connect Redis session invalidation on biometric revocation.
  - *Blockers*: Waiting for staging Redis cluster credentials from DevOps.
- **Engineer C (QA / E2E)**:
  - *Yesterday*: Configured Maestro UI automated test suite for FaceID success flow.
  - *Today*: Write negative test cases (expired biometric tokens, failed sensor prompts).
  - *Blockers*: Blocked by staging environment Redis downtime.

## 16th-Minute Unblocking Actions
- **DevOps Escalation**: Engineer B and C pairing with DevOps lead at 10:30 AM to restore staging Redis cluster credentials.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Everything is going well. We worked on authentication yesterday and will continue today.
